name: personal-project-portfolio
description: Personal Project Portfolio v2.0 — Admin Web, Public Web, Backend API

scripts.dev: pnpm build:shared && concurrently -n api,admin,public -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @ppp/api dev" "pnpm --filter @ppp/admin-web dev" "pnpm --filter @ppp/public-web dev"
